title: Google Trends Interest Signals
description: Captures Google Trends data via two channels: (1) Daily trending searches from Google Trends RSS feed for real-time attention spikes, and (2) SerpAPI Google Trends interest-over-time for tracked terms mapped to prediction market categories (if SERPAPI_KEY is available). Earliest signal for demand/attention shifts - when search interest rises but prediction market contract prices haven't moved, attention is about to become volume.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())
rows = []

def categorize_term(term_lower, politics, econ, weather, entertain, crypto):
    for w in politics:
        if w in term_lower:
            return 'politics'
    for w in econ:
        if w in term_lower:
            return 'economics'
    for w in weather:
        if w in term_lower:
            return 'weather'
    for w in entertain:
        if w in term_lower:
            return 'entertainment'
    for w in crypto:
        if w in term_lower:
            return 'crypto'
    return 'general'

politics_words = ['election', 'president', 'senate', 'congress', 'vote', 'poll', 'trump', 'biden']
econ_words = ['fed', 'inflation', 'cpi', 'rate', 'gdp', 'recession', 'unemployment', 'economy', 'tariff']
weather_words = ['hurricane', 'tornado', 'heat', 'snow', 'storm', 'weather', 'flood', 'wildfire']
entertain_words = ['oscar', 'grammy', 'emmy', 'super bowl', 'nfl', 'nba', 'mlb', 'box office', 'movie']
crypto_words = ['bitcoin', 'crypto', 'ethereum', 'coin']

# --- Channel 1: Google Trends RSS daily trending searches ---
try:
    rss_resp = requests.get(
        'https://trends.google.com/trends/trendingsearches/daily/rss',
        params={'geo': 'US'},
        timeout=30,
        headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'},
    )
    rss_resp.raise_for_status()
    from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
    soup = BeautifulSoup(rss_resp.text, 'lxml-xml')
    items = soup.find_all('item')
    for item in items[:50]:
        title = item.find('title')
        traffic = item.find('ht:approx_traffic')
        if traffic is None:
            traffic = item.find('approx_traffic')
        title_text = title.get_text(strip=True) if title else ''
        traffic_text = traffic.get_text(strip=True) if traffic else '0'
        traffic_num = int(re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', traffic_text)) if traffic_text else 0
        score = min(traffic_num // 1000, 100) if traffic_num > 0 else 0
        category = categorize_term(title_text.lower(), politics_words, econ_words, weather_words, entertain_words, crypto_words)
        rows.append({
            'search_term': title_text,
            'interest_score': score,
            'trend_direction': 'rising',
            'vs_30d_avg_pct': 0,
            'related_market_category': category,
            'geo': 'US',
            'timeframe': 'daily_trending',
            'is_trending': True,
            'source': 'rss',
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })
except Exception:
    pass

# --- Channel 2: SerpAPI Google Trends (if key available) ---
try:
    serpapi_key = CREDENTIALS.get('SERPAPI_KEY', '')
except Exception:
    serpapi_key = ''
if serpapi_key:
    TRACKED_TERMS = ['recession', 'inflation', 'CPI report', 'Fed rate decision', 'unemployment', 'hurricane', 'heat wave', 'snowstorm', 'election polls', 'Trump', 'Biden', 'box office', 'Oscar nominations', 'Super Bowl', 'bitcoin price']
    TRACKED_CATS = ['economics', 'economics', 'economics', 'economics', 'economics', 'weather', 'weather', 'weather', 'politics', 'politics', 'politics', 'entertainment', 'entertainment', 'entertainment', 'crypto']
    for ti in range(len(TRACKED_TERMS)):
        term = TRACKED_TERMS[ti]
        cat = TRACKED_CATS[ti]
        try:
            resp = requests.get(
                'https://serpapi.com/search.json',
                params={
                    'engine': 'google_trends',
                    'q': term,
                    'data_type': 'TIMESERIES',
                    'date': 'today 3-m',
                    'geo': 'US',
                    'api_key': serpapi_key,
                },
                timeout=30,
            )
            if resp.status_code == 429:
                time.sleep(5)
                continue
            resp.raise_for_status()
            data = resp.json()
            timeline = data.get('interest_over_time', {}).get('timeline_data', [])
            if timeline:
                recent = timeline[len(timeline) - 1]
                values = recent.get('values', [{}])
                current_score = int(values[0].get('extracted_value', 0)) if values else 0
                avg_points = []
                for ai in range(max(0, len(timeline) - 5), len(timeline) - 1):
                    pt = timeline[ai]
                    pv = pt.get('values', [{}])
                    if pv:
                        avg_points.append(int(pv[0].get('extracted_value', 0)))
                avg_30d = sum(avg_points) / len(avg_points) if avg_points else 0
                vs_avg = round((current_score - avg_30d) / avg_30d * 100, 1) if avg_30d > 0 else 0
                direction = 'rising' if vs_avg > 10 else 'falling' if vs_avg < -10 else 'stable'
                rows.append({
                    'search_term': term,
                    'interest_score': current_score,
                    'trend_direction': direction,
                    'vs_30d_avg_pct': vs_avg,
                    'related_market_category': cat,
                    'geo': 'US',
                    'timeframe': 'past_3_months',
                    'is_trending': vs_avg > 50,
                    'source': 'serpapi',
                    '_epoch': now_epoch,
                })
        except Exception:
            continue
        time.sleep(1.5)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
